headline: Executive order sets up a White House initiative focused on Historically Black Colleges and Universities and the educational and economic opportunities they provide.
what_it_does: This order creates or continues a White House Initiative centered on Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs). Based on its title, the initiative aims to advance educational equity, excellence, and economic opportunity through these schools. No summary was provided, so specific details such as funding, staffing, or required actions are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The schools are the focus of a White House initiative meant to support their role in education and economic opportunity.
The initiative is aimed at expanding educational and economic opportunities connected to these schools, though specific benefits are not described in the available material.
Agencies may be involved in carrying out the initiative, but the available material does not say how.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 3, 2021; executive orders typically take effect when signed.
